heimdall.lesson: Odin sent a case back because this was missing after the first investigation: "Quantitative monthly data for alternative <place> exports and <place> rail loadings to <place> and <place>." (source types: official_trade_table, customs_data). Search for this kind of evidence in the first investigation and list it in the Case File.
heimdall.context: case case-20261025-204050-ac35da run 1: Quantitative monthly data for alternative Vanir exports and Ravik rail loadings to Midgard and Tolan. | why: Required to calculate net economic loss by accounting for substitution effects.

heimdall.lesson: Odin sent a case back because this was missing after the first investigation: "Complete monthly trade volume and value series for <place> maize imports from <place>." (source types: official_trade_table, trade_note). Search for this kind of evidence in the first investigation and list it in the Case File.
heimdall.context: case case-20261025-204050-ac35da run 1: Complete monthly trade volume and value series for Tolan maize imports from Orvan. | why: Required to calculate trade exposure range for Tolan maize imports following corridor expiration.

heimdall.lesson: Corrections, retractions or contradicting reports changed the record of the event. Search for correction and retraction notices and official notices before setting the event status.

loki.lesson: I conceded a claim (citing shipping_update, trade_note) after the opponent showed counter-evidence from trade_note: "Loki provides no net import data or quantitative evidence showing <place> wheat shipments fully offset or substantially reduced <place>'s di...". Before making this kind of claim, look for that evidence myself and state the limitation.
loki.context: case case-20261025-204050-ac35da run 1: L1-3 conceded - Loki conceded (C-A1-T1) that while alternative Vanir wheat shipments existed, they were smaller than the lost Orvan sea trade and insufficient to eliminate Tolan's exposure gap.

loki.lesson: I conceded a claim (citing trade_note) after the opponent showed counter-evidence from trade_note: "Loki provides no evidence that delayed delivery terms offered structural buffering rather than merely postponing the onset of a major import...". Before making this kind of claim, look for that evidence myself and state the limitation.
loki.context: case case-20261025-204050-ac35da run 1: L1-2 conceded - Loki conceded (C-A1-T3) that delayed delivery terms provided only temporary buffering in October 2026, and that Midgard maize imports contracted sharply in November and December 2026.

thor.lesson: An estimate of the metric "YoY import value loss" (USD M) computed with trade_calc from trade_note evidence (tier 2) was established; this metric definition held up.
thor.context: case case-20261025-204050-ac35da run 1: T1-3 established - Trade notes in ORV-0046 demonstrate immediate and persistent YoY drops in Tolan wheat imports from Orvan. Loki conceded (C-A1-T1) that alternative shipments from Vanir were smaller than the trade gap and could not offset the exposure.
